reason: The Swamp's mana is otherwise wasted, and killing Momo removes the flier that discounts their Dragons; the case for A is saving Hex for Voice of Victory or Sarkhan.
A two-land hand against aggro wants cheap spells; the six-black-mana Excruciator is dead for many turns, though it could have been discard fodder for Bitter Triumph.
I am at 1 life facing four attackers with three blockers, so one attacker gets through and I lose either way.

Keeping the Treasure gets the second Saga to four Treasures and a 6/6 Dragon a turn sooner, and the Elves are free to attack while Dwalin is tapped; A spends the Treasure and Elves mana on the slow Obsessive Pursuit.
B cannot be cast: Uldaros costs 7 and only 6 mana is available after the land drop, while A at least uses its mana on Duress.
The 1/1 Cryomancer trades with the 2/1 Enlightened Confidant, a card-advantage engine; at 22 life the Cryomancer is cheap to lose and keeps its graveyard draw ability.
Torch is an instant and nothing else costs 1, so holding it keeps the same Miner kill (exiling it) available on their turn with the option of a better target.
Voice of Victory stops me casting spells on their turn, so passing with nothing cast wastes the whole turn; exiling Voice with a 3-point drain and then casting Consult uses all six mana.
Their hand is empty and two high-count Ascensions would grow Chocobo every land drop; Countersculpt (Jace beheld, so UU) hard-counters it, while No More Lies fails against their 10 open mana.

Starcage now exiles only one Llanowar Elves; holding up Countersculpt or Three Steps Ahead (or Consult at end step) for their four-drop is better, saving Starcage for when they have more cheap creatures.
